candidates: When constructing a batch/run identifier that must be consistent across parallel Cypress shards (e.g., for visual snapshot tooling), derive it from a stable shared value rather than a local time-based one. The project convention is to read the commit hash from `Cypress.env('CYPRESS_COMMIT')`, which GitHub Actions injects via `${{ github.sha }}`; using `Date.now()` or `new Date().getTime()` will produce a different ID on each shard and break batch correlation.
TypeScript `interface` declarations should end with a trailing semicolon after the closing brace (e.g., `interface Foo { ... };`).
